title: Binocle
summary: BIN'OCLE, noun [binus, double, and oculus, and eye.] A dioptric telescope, fitted with two tubes joining, so as to enable a person to view an object with both eyes at once.

inlines.v: BIN'OCLE, noun [binus, double, and oculus, and eye.] A dioptric telescope, fitted with two tubes joining, so as to enable a person to view an object with both eyes at once.
